commands.name: isolated-source-import
command:
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import gridsense,opendssdirect,numpy,pyarrow
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
assert Path(sys.prefix).resolve()==root/'.venv'
assert 'include-system-site-packages = false' in (root/'.venv/pyvenv.cfg').read_text()
assert Path(gridsense.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root/'backend')
for module in [opendssdirect,numpy,pyarrow]:
 assert Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root/'.venv')
print(json.dumps({'source':'backend/gridsense','isolated_python_environment':True,'dependencies_in_new_venv':True,'python':sys.version.split()[0]},indent=2))
